If StbM_GetTxFreshness or StbM_GetTxFreshnessTruncData return a non- recoverable error code (i.e, E_NOT_OK ), the Time Master shall: • stop the ICV generation and accordingly fill 0 for FVL and ICVL fields in message types 0x78 and 0x88 , • call Det_ReportRuntimeError with the parameter ErrorId set to CANTSYN_ E_FRESHNESSFAILURE , • and report the security event SEV_TSYN_CAN_FRESHNESS_NOT_AVAILABLE to the IdsM .
